text: Name a country that no longer exists.
flavor: Borders shift like sand. Whole nations sink beneath the tide of history and are never seen again.
rules: Any country, empire or kingdom that no longer exists, including old colonies. A country that was only renamed, like Ceylon, doesn't count.

answers.lore: Dissolved on 26 December 1991, the day after Gorbachev resigned.

aliases: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes
